workflows.visualEditor.hint.connectSteps: Conecte as etapas arrastando das alças
workflows.visualEditor.hint.copyPaste: Select steps and copy, paste or duplicate them with Cmd/Ctrl+C, +V and +D
workflows.visualEditor.hint.dragFromPale: Drag a step onto the canvas, or onto a route to insert it there
workflows.visualEditor.hint.editSteps: Clique nas etapas e transições para editá-las
workflows.visualEditor.hint.keyboardCanv: With a step selected: Enter opens it, Del removes it, arrows nudge it (hold Shift for bigger steps)
workflows.visualEditor.interpolation.hel: Controls what happens when a variable placeholder cannot be resolved at run time: strict fails the step so problems surface immediately; lenient keeps the unresolved text unchanged. New workflows start strict.
workflows.visualEditor.interpolation.len: Lenient — keep the text as written
workflows.visualEditor.keyboard.nothingS: Select a step or a route first
workflows.visualEditor.metadata.descript: Everything about this workflow except its graph — identity, presentation, availability, inputs and runtime behaviour.
workflows.visualEditor.metadata.lockedAf: Fixed once the workflow exists. Publish a new version to change it.
workflows.visualEditor.metadata.readOnly: This workflow is defined in code and cannot be edited here.
workflows.visualEditor.metadata.required: Workflow ID and name are required.
workflows.visualEditor.metadata.sections: Whether this workflow may start, and the window in which it may.
The ID and version are the unique key the engine resolves a running instance against, so both are fixed after creation. The name and description are what people read.
The context data this workflow starts with. Triggers are edited from the Start node on the canvas.
How this workflow is recognised and found in lists.
What the engine does when a variable cannot be resolved or a step fails with nothing wired to catch it.
workflows.visualEditor.metadata.title: Workflow details
workflows.visualEditor.palette.dragActio: Drop an action onto a route to add it there
Data mapping links are edited in the step configuration, not on the canvas.
workflows.visualEditor.problems.branchin: Branching step "{stepId}" has no unconditioned route; add an otherwise route so the workflow cannot stall when no condition matches
workflows.visualEditor.problems.conditio: Condition path "{path}" is not provided by any earlier step, trigger, or input
workflows.visualEditor.problems.duplicat: Branching step "{stepId}" has more than one route for {caseValue}; only the highest-priority one can ever match
workflows.visualEditor.problems.errorRou: Error route "{transitionId}" shares its source and target with a normal route; the engine cannot tell them apart
Error route "{transitionId}" starts at unknown step "{stepId}"
workflows.visualEditor.problems.outcomeR: Agent step "{stepId}" has more than one route for the "{outcomeKind}" outcome; only the highest-priority one can ever be taken
Outcome route "{transitionId}" claims outcome "{outcomeKind}", which the platform does not define; it can never be selected
workflows.visualEditor.problems.saveBloc: Cannot save: {count} validation error(s) found. Please fix them first.
workflows.visualEditor.problems.taskBind: Task "{stepId}" is about "{entityType}", which {roles} may not view; assignees holding only those roles would not see the task
Task "{stepId}" is about "{entityType}", which is not a known record type; the task would be hidden from its own assignee
workflows.visualEditor.problems.taskDeci: Task "{stepId}" has more than one decision with the id "{decisionId}"; only one of them can ever be recorded
Decision "{decisionId}" on task "{stepId}" points at route "{transitionId}", which no longer leaves this step
workflows.visualEditor.problems.taskPort: Task "{stepId}" is addressed to a customer but is about no record; a portal task is only visible to the customer whose record it is linked to, so nobody in the portal would see it
workflows.visualEditor.problems.taskWith: Task "{stepId}" names neither an assignee nor a role queue, so nobody can complete it and the workflow will stall there
workflows.visualEditor.problems.title: Problems
workflows.visualEditor.problems.unmapped: Step "{stepId}" keeps unmapped configuration from an earlier type change ({keys}); it is stored but no longer executed
workflows.visualEditor.problems.unresolv: Context reference "{path}" is not provided by any earlier step, trigger, or input
workflows.visualEditor.problems.validati: Validation passed! Your workflow is valid and ready to save.
workflows.visualEditor.tapToAdd: Toque em um tipo de etapa para adicioná-lo à tela
workflows.visualEditor.tapToAddBelow: Toque em um tipo de etapa abaixo para adicioná-lo à tela

workflows.workInbox.empty.entityHidden.t: Some work is hidden from this account
